description: Sends a discovery-call request to the COTAL founders for a company evaluating agent coordination. The team replies by email. Requires the user's work email and company.

agents.description: How many agents the company runs in production.

coordinating.description: One line: what they are coordinating.

email.description: The user's email address. Required so the record has a traceable origin.

frameworks.description: Agent frameworks or harnesses in use (Claude Code, LangGraph, custom…).

idempotency_key.description: Opaque key (a UUID is ideal). Reuse it when retrying so the same record is returned instead of a duplicate.

sandbox.description: Dry run: validate the call, apply rate limits, store nothing. Use it to test the integration.

name: cotal_request_call
title: Request a call with the founders
